documents.title: De-linking extension where contributions exist
documents.authority: EPFO administrative circular (original scan retrieved from mirror)
notes: Official PDF URL returned 404/403. Retrieved copy checked visually against circular date, number and indexed text; issuer-hosted bytes could not be independently compared.

evidence.quote: Authority has approved the extension of this functionality

relationships.scope: Extends the January 2025 MID de-linking functionality to wrongly created MIDs with contributions, subject to specified contribution/claim conditions; does not supersede the full manual.

limitations: De-linking a wrong MID is separate from correcting Aadhaar, merging genuine service, transferring balances or correcting EPS contributions.
The 2026 circular says separate instructions will follow for transfer of de-linked balances to SRF; no automatic balance-transfer outcome is inferred.
Both full manuals are extracted, but screenshots and OCR may contain errors. Cover instructions and manual validation tables must be reconciled; no date-of-joining cutoff is certified here.
January manual version 1.0 dated 11 January is distinct from the circular issue date of 17 January.
2026 original URL is unavailable; a mirror copy is retained, with issuer-hosted byte identity unverified.
Issue-date filtering does not establish operational availability or legal commencement.
